pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe sattarasavaggiyā dārakā sahāyakā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.5: kena nu kho upāyena upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.7: sace kho upāli lekhaṃ sikkheyya evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.9: sace kho upāli lekhaṃ sikkhissati aṅguliyo dukkhā bhavissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.10: sace kho upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkheyya evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.12: sace kho upāli gaṇanaṃ sikkhissati urassa dukkho bhavissati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.13: sace kho upāli rūpaṃ sikkheyya evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyyāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.15: sace kho upāli rūpaṃ sikkhissati akkhīnissa dukkhāni bhavissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.16: ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sukhasīlā sukhasamācārā subhojanāni bhuñjitvā nivātesu sayanesu sayanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.17: sace kho upāli samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajeyya evaṃ kho upāli amhākaṃ accayena sukhañca jīveyya na ca kilameyayāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.18: assosi kho upāli dārako mātāpitūnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.19: athakho upāli dārako yena te dārakā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te dārake etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.20: etha mayaṃ ayyā samaṇesu sakyaputtiyesu pabbajissāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.21: sace kho tvaṃ ayya pabbajissasi evaṃ mayaṃpi pabbajissāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.22: athakho te dārakā ekamekassa mātāpitaro upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.29: yāguṃ detha bhattaṃ detha khādanīyaṃ dethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.35: no ce bhavissati yāgu vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjissathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.36: evaṃpi kho te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā rodantiyeva
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.37: yāguṃ detha bhattaṃ detha khādanīyaṃ dethāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.39: assosi kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dārakasaddaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.41: kiṃ nu kho so ānanda dārakasaddoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.42: athakho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.43: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.44: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.47: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādessanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.48: ūnavīsativasso bhikkhave puggalo akkhamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātiko hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.49: vīsativasso ca kho bhikkhave puggalo khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.51: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.52: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:1.53.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādeyya so ca puggalo anupasampanno te ca bhikkhū gārayhā idaṃ tasmiṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:2.1.9: upasampādessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc65:2.1.13: gaṇassa ca ācariyassa ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
